# Overrides applied when compiling semgrep.txt (uv pip compile --override).
#
# pyjwt: semgrep pins pyjwt[crypto]~=2.13.0 (1.177.0 and 1.178.0 alike), and every
# 2.13.x is affected by GHSA-w6j9-cwv2-h6wq and the other advisories fixed in 2.14.0.
# 2.14.0 is a security-only release with no API changes, and semgrep imports jwt only
# in its MCP server, never in `semgrep scan`, which is all semgrep.yaml runs.
# semgrep.yaml installs with --no-deps so pip does not re-apply semgrep's pin. Delete
# this line once a semgrep release allows pyjwt 2.14.
pyjwt[crypto]~=2.14.0
